project.title: MOSAiC aerosol and related source sample amplicon sequencing data
project.description: This is the Multidisciplinary drifting Observatory for the Study of Arctic Climate (MOSAiC) expedition aerosol and source sample DNA fastq files for samples collected in the central Arctic. All samples were collected near the surface, unless indicated, within the CTD sample name. Please email Kevin Barry, kevin.barry@colostate, if there are any questions with this dataset.
